Specifically, they recommend creating a solid budgeting plan to categorize income and expenses, distinguishing between needs and discretionary spending. They advise saving at least 20% of income consistently and setting up automatic transfers to savings. For investing, they suggest diversifying investments across different types to reduce risk and investing for the long-term.
